issues: 'Shared with pros' and 'Child Goals' nav labels wrap onto 2-3 lines, so the header looks crowded (cosmetic, likely pre-existing)

critical_code_review_comments: mediation_sharing.prepare does nothing if the user has not accepted the AI notice, and falls back to goals + agenda. Correct, but the share_copy is cached forever: a later rewrite will not run if prep data changes (acceptable because the doc is a snapshot).
